newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CDL Investments seeks more NZ land.
newsitem.headline: CDL Investments seeks more NZ land.

text.p: CDL Investments Ltd said on Friday it was still actively seeking land investment opportunities particularly in growth areas in New Zealand.
Earlier, it reported a year net profit of NZ$9.09 million, up from $6.67 million a year ago.

During the course of the year the company had settled the only remaining litigation concerning a joint venture company property development in 1987. Liability continued to be denied and the company had agreed to discontinue the proceedings in consideration of the payment of $1.3 million, CDL said.

While the professional property services operation had a difficult year compounded by further rationalisation, land based investment and development activity continued to be the main focus of the company. The land development activities of the company continue to thrive with sales of 307 sections achieved.
Section prices in most areas continued to appreciate during the year.
"CDL Investments remains confident of the realisation potential of its current 473 hectare land portfolio," CDL said.
In value terms, 33 percent of the portfolio is weighted in Hamilton, while 49 percent is weighted in Auckland, with the balance spread across the country.

The company's residential waterfront development project at Waimanu Bay was due to be launched in April and was expected to contribute significantly to profitability in the next few years. "To further capitalise on the strength of the market for properties with water views, the company has confirmed the purchase of an intensive housing site at Westharbour for $1.1 million. The site which already boasts a substantial residence, will be further developed immediately with the first of 14 units
available to the market by year end," CDL said.
